description: A VARIANT JSON null cast to a primitive type is SQL NULL in Snowflake - from PARSE_JSON directly, from a VARIANT-typed column, and from a path access - while a plain 'null' VARCHAR keeps its text and a cast back to VARIANT keeps the JSON null (so it is not SQL NULL). Loaders diff semi-structured columns as col::VARCHAR; a text-'null' result would make every seeded PARSE_JSON('null') column compare unequal to SQL NULL. Converted 1:1 from features/VariantJsonNullCastTest (now retired); the assertNull checks are expressed as IS NULL projections so an absent value cannot be confused with the four-character text.

steps.sql: SELECT v::VARCHAR IS NULL FROM vjn
